# OSIA Transport LLC SPC
> Reliable Transport, Water Supply & Heavy Equipment Rental Solutions in Abu Dhabi, UAE.

## Core Services
1. Sweet Water Supply (Drinking / Potable water tankers for camps, commercial, and construction sites)
2. Non-Drinking Water Supply (Civil construction, dust control, soil compaction, site washing)
3. Salt Water Supply (Subgrade compaction, haul road dust suppression, industrial applications)
4. Wastewater Collection & Drainage (High-suction vacuum tankers, septic tank cleaning, safe disposal)
5. Mobile Crane Rental (25 Ton, 50 Ton, 100 Ton, 200 Ton all-terrain cranes with certified operators)
6. Low Bed Trailer Services (Heavy plant, tracked excavators, oversized equipment transport)
7. Flatbed Trailer Transportation (Structural steel, pipes, precast concrete, general freight)

- Musaffah Industrial Area & ICAD

- Mohammed Bin Zayed City (MBZ)
